purpose: Define audit that semantic identity is never replaced by labels/paths/ports/URLs/hostnames/UI nodes/index hits or projections.

topics.name: Identity, Address and Projection Separation Audit
topics.purpose: Define audit that semantic identity is never replaced by labels/paths/ports/URLs/hostnames/UI nodes/index hits or projections.

semantics.rule: Each surface may bind/project an exact semantic identity but cannot become it implicitly.
semantics.finding_rule: Ambiguous identity inference from presentation/addressing is a finding.
semantics.migration_rule: Existing path-derived IDs require explicit identity migration if they violate canonical identity rules.
semantics.authority_rule: Address/projection visibility does not grant authority.

invariants.rule: Whole-tree reconciliation operates only on exact accepted/candidate source snapshots, identities, references and declared semantics; it never repairs ambiguity through filename, path order, timestamp, nearest-name or UI layout heuristics.

A contract, closure set or repository remains unlocked/not-ready until all required reconciliation findings for its declared readiness profile are explicitly resolved or accepted through an explicit bounded exception.

hard_gates.condition: UI node id equals resource identity accidentally
